# Nirium

> Payment, audit and execution rails on Stellar for apps, backends and AI agents.
> Non-custodial: your keys, your funds. Not financial advice.

## Network scope
- Stellar mainnet, open: x402 per-request billing, Audit Trail (receipts anchored on IPFS), Reporting.
- Stellar mainnet, invite-only: Payouts, Treasury.
- MPP Charge (Machine Payments Protocol): experimental, verified on testnet, untested on mainnet. For paid access on mainnet, use x402.
- NiriumVault, Nirium's own contract, stays on testnet until an external audit.

## Packages (versions checked 2026-11-16)
- npm: nirium 0.19.6, nirium-mcp 0.6.8, nirium-cli 3.2.4, nirium-pollar-adapter 0.6.5
- PyPI: nirium 0.12.6

## CLI (nirium-cli)
- `nirium anchor --hash <hex> | --file <path> | --record <json>`: anchor to IPFS via an Audit Trail node; `--sign --key-env <VAR>` adds an ed25519 attestation.
- `nirium verify <cid>`: checks hash and signature locally; tries several IPFS gateways in order.
- `nirium report summary` / `nirium report export anchors|payments|payroll`: your own records from the Reporting node (not certified regulatory reporting).
